title: Add TUI command parser, help and explain errors
purpose: Implement a typed parser and operator help model that makes safe actions discoverable without shell escape.
scope: Implement parser output enum for TUI commands.
Implement help output grouped by dashboard, run, approval, recovery, audit, support and aom.
Implement explainable parse errors with fail-closed behavior.
Reject pipes, redirection, command substitution and shell metacharacter execution patterns.
Add parser fixtures for valid and invalid commands.
acceptance_criteria: Parser output is typed and cannot be passed directly to a shell.
Help text lists only supported AgentOS operations.
Errors explain the rejected grammar rule without echoing sensitive payloads.
failure_modes: Parser stores raw untrusted command text as executable action.
Parse errors leak secrets from command input.
